alt: A close-up of a sculpted cake figure with black hair and face paint features a detailed black bird with spread wings perched on its head.
A hyper-realistic cake sculpture depicts a Native American figure with black and white face paint, a raven perched on their head, and beaded moccasins arranged on the display board.
A hyper-realistic cake sculpture depicts a bust of a Native American figure with face paint and a raven perched on their head, accompanied by detailed fondant moccasins and a beaded necklace.

A pair of tan leather beaded moccasins featuring intricate geometric patterns in red, white, blue, and yellow rests on a black display tray alongside a mannequin wearing traditional Native American attire.
